About SafePsy

Our Mission

Mental health support safer, more private, and globally accessible.

SafePsy combines:

Ethical AI assistance. Blockchain-secured identity. Encrypted at rest with user-controlled keys.

You own your data. We do not store it with third parties or use it to train AI models.

Secure

Security is the foundation of SafePsy's ecosystem: Data is encrypted at rest and in transit, and encryption keys are controlled by you (derived from your wallet). Message content is processed by our AI provider to generate responses; we do not log or persistently store plaintext.

Ethical

We aim to operate in line with professional ethics and guidelines for psychological services. The AI assistant is not a substitute for professional care and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

Human-centered

At SafePsy, technology serves people, not the other way around. Human dignity and care are at the heart of everything we build.

Our Technology

SafePsy integrates AI, blockchain, and secure digital identity to support mental wellness and therapy-adjacent use cases worldwide. Users control their data through decentralized identity and wallet-derived encryption keys. Saved chat is ciphertext in our database; each AI request sends message content over HTTPS to our API and LLM provider (not strict end-to-end encryption).

AI-Powered

We do not use your chat content to train our models. The assistant supports reflection and session preparation, and is designed to complement (not replace) licensed care.

Blockchain Security

The backbone of our security: decentralized identity on the blockchain provides transparency and trust, and ensures users own and control their identity and encryption keys.

Global Access

Both psychologists and patients can use the platform from anywhere in the world with our accessible pricing.

Frequently asked questions

SafePsy is a privacy-first mental wellness platform that combines ethical AI support with blockchain-secured identity. Use Dr. Safe to digest your thoughts or reflect between therapy sessions. You own your data: we do not store it with third parties or use it to train AI models. Chat and summary data are encrypted at rest; keys are derived from your wallet and are not stored on our servers. After every chat, you have the choice to save, or not, your data on your wallet.

You can start chatting, to see how it works. Then connect your wallet, create your ID token and experience safe discussions where you own your privacy.

Today, most discussions with AI are owned by platforms, used to train models and stored by third parties. SafePsy gives you privacy combined with continuity across sessions: own your data and your story. Dr.Safe is a more personal and contextual AI experience designed to assist you with your thoughts, made by psychologists.

SafePsy is different in two major points: It is designed around data privacy to facilitate free association with your thoughts, without feeling observed. It is designed by psychologists to ensure a legitimate assistance to users, in adequation with HIPAA Compliance.

Your ID token is where you own and store your encrypted chat references. It is a on-chain token (soulbound tied to your wallet). After connecting your wallet and creating your ID Token, save encrypted chats and retrieve history.

Yes. You can chat instantly as a guest for a limited, session-style experience. Connecting a wallet allows you to create your ID token, save encrypted chat and retrieve history the next session.

You own your private keys and control your decntralized wallet. We do not log chat message content and we do not use your chats to train our models. Chat and summary data are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM; only ciphertext is stored. Data is transmitted over TLS 1.3 and sensitive content is encrypted client-side before sending.

No. The AI assistant is not a substitute for professional mental health care. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Dr. Safe is built to support you between therapy sessions, when preparing for an appointment, organizing thoughts or emotions, or practicing coping tools. SafePsy complements licensed therapy; it does not replace it. Always consult licensed professionals for clinical decisions. If you are in crisis, contact a licensed professional or emergency services.
